evidence_scope: Curated flaky-test inventory bound to the current tracked static test-governance fingerprint. This inventory does not replace repeated-run CI telemetry or claim that static analysis can detect intermittent outcomes.

flaky_test_definition: intermittent pass/fail outcome across repeated or sharded runs
timing-sensitive assertion without a bounded deterministic seam
nondeterministic ID, clock, random, VCR, fixture, or golden-data behavior
remediation_workflow: stabilize with deterministic clock, ID, and fixture seams
quarantine only with owner, triage_status, cause, and removal condition
do not hide nondeterminism with retries or relaxed assertions
